purpose: Resolve general-theory defects that can make a mechanistic insurgency model spatially diffuse or numerically confound distinct hazards before consuming another pristine empirical validation surface.

repairs.problem: Action execution currently uses one organization-wide local_knowledge scalar even though membership, formations, control, and information are locality-specific. This permits competence acquired in one locality to improve execution everywhere.
repairs.repair: Derive local operational knowledge from existing local armed membership/rootedness, equipped local cell capacity, fielded formation embeddedness, own local institutional/control state, and actor-held local target beliefs. Retain the organization-wide scalar only as general tradecraft. Do not add a fitted coefficient.
rejection_tests: equal national tradecraft with a planted local cell produces higher operational knowledge only in the planted locality
moving a field formation away does not erase local knowledge when local members/equipped cells remain
removing local members, cells, formations, institutions, and actor evidence collapses local operational knowledge
mutating hidden opponent truth while holding actor beliefs fixed cannot change local operational knowledge
local information evidence improves knowledge only in its observed locality

repairs.problem: Deliberate organized-action opportunities and chance/directional formation contacts share SimulationConfig.contact_rate despite representing different causal processes.
repairs.repair: Introduce organized_action_rate as an independent general-theory hazard. Preserve the pre-repair baseline numerically by initializing it to the former common rate rather than selecting a value from historical fit.
rejection_tests: changing contact_rate with organized_action_rate fixed cannot change action_attempt_probability
changing organized_action_rate with contact_rate fixed changes action_attempt_probability monotonically
zero organized_action_rate implies zero deliberate organized-action opportunities while contact remains available
calendar-time composition of action opportunity remains invariant to scan partition

repairs.problem: A model can beat a global event-rate baseline yet lose to province/region empirical Bayes if persistent local organizational state does not create persistent local violence risk.
repairs.repair: Do not add event self-excitation. Require persistent hotspots to emerge from durable local organization, information, logistics, membership, and governance stocks.
rejection_tests: a planted durable local base has higher repeated-action propensity than an otherwise matched locality
removing the base collapses that excess risk
moving only the field formation while retaining the clandestine base preserves nonzero residual risk
shuffling the base across localities destroys locality-specific alignment while conserving national capacity
event occurrence itself is not permitted to write a generic future-event hazard

repairs.problem: Information-source quality currently partly inherits organization-wide local_knowledge, allowing source competence to teleport across localities.
repairs.repair: Use the same derived local organizational embeddedness for source-quality contributions while preserving source-type, language, observability, terrain, and formation-information terms.
rejection_tests: equal source type and national organization state produce higher source quality where local embeddedness exists
source quality cannot increase in an untreated locality merely because another locality becomes embedded

forbidden_changes: no parameter or mechanism may be chosen from Afghan War Diary labels
no Afghan War Diary row-level data may be acquired during theory hardening
no parameter may be chosen to reverse the failed 2005 score
no event-history Hawkes/self-excitation term may be added merely because historical violence clusters
no province, region, ethnic, or named-place coefficient may be hard-coded
promotion_gate: all new synthetic rejection tests pass
existing truth-firewall and accounting tests pass
existing spatial identification recovery remains green
short synthetic planted-hotspot ensemble demonstrates local persistence without event self-excitation
representative-resolution and calendar-time invariance remain acceptable
only after these pass may a new empirical source/year be resealed
